notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
🏖️ Summer Update Now Live!
Grab your shades and blast off — the Combine 2 Pumpkins Summer Update is here!
This chilled-out content drop brings:

🌴 Two Brand-New Maps
Sunny Beach – A tropical getaway filled with sand, palm trees, and lots of sun.

Planet Gourd – A sci-fi adventure set on an alien world filled with interstellar atmosphere. 

🧙‍♀️ Past Seasonal Maps Return!
For the first time ever, all past seasonal levels are unlocked and playable — from spooky nights to snowy peaks and everything in between. Play your favorite map or switch it up and play a random map every time!

🎥 Trailer
Check out the trailer and catch the summer vibe:
[previewyoutube=2J4ZCtk3m_0;full][/previewyoutube]

Available today — no time limits, just sunshine and squashes.

See you on the beach (or the spaceship)!🧃
